title: Tension erupts outside Vanchiyoor court after verdict in Ranjith murder case

ai.summary: Political tensions erupted outside Vanchiyoor District Court following a murder verdict, with BJP and CPI(M) workers clashing over accusations of provocative slogans and police bias.

facts.claim: Tension prevailed outside the Vanchiyoor District Court complex after the court delivered its verdict in the Mannanthala Ranjith murder case on Tuesday.
facts.quote: Tension prevailed outside the Vanchiyoor District Court complex after the court delivered its verdict in the Mannanthala Ranjith murder case on Tuesday.

facts.claim: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and Communist Party of India (Marxist) [CPI(M)] workers confronted each other, while police personnel also faced resistance from protesters as the convicts were escorted out of the court premises.
facts.quote: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and Communist Party of India (Marxist) [CPI(M)] workers confronted each other, while police personnel also faced resistance from protesters as the convicts were escorted out of the court premises.

facts.claim: Around ten minutes after the verdict was pronounced, a police bus carrying the 11 convicts emerged through the court gate. A large number of BJP workers who had gathered outside the court raised slogans against the convicts.
facts.quote: Around ten minutes after the verdict was pronounced, a police bus carrying the 11 convicts emerged through the court gate. A large number of BJP workers who had gathered outside the court raised slogans against the convicts.

facts.claim: This prompted the convicted men to shout back and allegedly hurl abuses at the BJP workers from within the bus.
facts.quote: This prompted the convicted men to shout back and allegedly hurl abuses at the BJP workers from within the bus.

facts.claim: As the situation intensified, the police attempted to disperse the BJP protesters. However, the protesters resisted, leading to a scuffle between them and the police personnel.
facts.quote: As the situation intensified, the police attempted to disperse the BJP protesters. However, the protesters resisted, leading to a scuffle between them and the police personnel.

facts.claim: The situation took a further turn when local CPI(M) workers reached the area, thereby triggering heated arguments and confrontations between the rival groups.
facts.quote: The situation took a further turn when local CPI(M) workers reached the area, thereby triggering heated arguments and confrontations between the rival groups.

facts.claim: The CPI(M) workers alleged that the BJP workers had raised provocative slogans outside the court and accused the police of supporting the BJP protesters.
facts.quote: The CPI(M) workers alleged that the BJP workers had raised provocative slogans outside the court and accused the police of supporting the BJP protesters.

facts.claim: Despite repeated appeals from senior police officials, including an Assistant Commissioner of Police, to disperse, both groups refused to leave the area.
facts.quote: Despite repeated appeals from senior police officials, including an Assistant Commissioner of Police, to disperse, both groups refused to leave the area.
A few political activists who continued to argue with the police were forcibly taken into custody.

facts.claim: The City police have stepped up security in an around the court premises to prevent a further escalation of tension. Security will also been intensified in the region on Wednesday on account of the scheduled pronouncement of sentences.
facts.quote: The City police have stepped up security in an around the court premises to prevent a further escalation of tension. Security will also been intensified in the region on Wednesday on account of the scheduled pronouncement of sentences.
